notes.title: Home-Screen Fix
notes.content: Fixed: Home-Screen loop was not displaying for users without the Windows HEVC (H265) Extension. Now H264-based, same as the default main content file.

tags.bug: Fixed: Home-Screen loop was not displaying for users without the Windows HEVC (H265) Extension.

notes.title: German Voice-Over Added
notes.content:
Conscious Existence now has a German female voice-over, as well as an additional option to auto-load saved settings at startup.

[b]Full Changelog
[/b]
- German Voice Over Integration
- Added: option to auto-load saved settings on app-start
- Fixed: bug with a hand pose not working correctly
- Fixed: bug with correctly loading the user-saved sampling resolution
- Fixed: download progress bar was not updating when app paused
- Added note that headset can be removed while downloading

tags.feature: - Added: option to auto-load saved settings on app-start

tags.bug: - Fixed: bug with a hand pose not working correctly
- Fixed: bug with correctly loading the user-saved sampling resolution
- Fixed: download progress bar was not updating when app paused

tags.feature: - Added note that headset can be removed while downloading

notes.title: FIXED - Controller Issues
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Controller issues which were introduced with [b]recent SteamVR updates[/b] have now been fixed,  it should work fine again with all headsets and controllers.
[*] Keyboard shortcuts as fallback solution have been made more obvious directly in the UI.
[/list]

notes.title: Index Support and Keyboard Shortcuts Added
notes.content:
[list]
[*] App now also works on the [u][b]Index VR Headset[/b][/u]

[*] Added [u][b]Keyboard Shortcuts[/b][/u]: Play/Pause - Space; R - Reset View; L - Toggle Voice-Over. 
Make sure the app [u]window is in focus[/u] for those to work.
[/list]

Added Keyboard Shortcuts: Play/Pause - Space; R - Reset View; L - Toggle Voice-Over.

notes.title: NOW UPDATED || Toggle Voice // Reset View // Black Levels
notes.content:
[list]
[*] You can now [b][u]turn off[/u][/b] the girl's [b][u]voice-over[/u][/b] using your Vive/Touch controllers if you wish.
[*] [b][u]View can be re-oriented[/u][/b] horizontally as well as vertically if you like, so you may also lie down while watching. 
[*] [b][u]Black Levels[/u][/b] have been [b][u]reduced[/u][/b] (= more perceived contrast) to a point that is more pleasant to the eyes, as much as it was possible without introducing any artifacts.
[/list]

Hope you enjoy! ːsteamhappyː

P.S: I'm planning to add the [u][b]WIN7/8 compatible version[/b][/u] with a bit reduced resolution as DLC package, so not everyone has to download an extra 10GB. Coming soon - but until then just shoot me an e-mail after purchase and I'll set you up (address see support contact info).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35136407/c904d2d9a4c48d343c94372fac2d589fc21c687d.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update to Toggle Voice Over
notes.content:
As this was requested a couple of times there will soon be an update with a switch to toggle the [b][u]voice over on/off[/u][/b] as well as probably a re-center button. 
I'm planning to release the update by the end of June latest.
